title: An AI agent startup just let its agent run its $100M fundraise
slides: Could an AI agent negotiate your next funding round?
This startup's agent handled its own $100M raise.
No human pitched—just code, strategy, and data.
Your fundraising process just became automatable.
Test your pitch against an agent before meeting VCs.
thread_text:
1. The silent pitch

A startup raised $100M with no human presenting—just an AI agent.

2. Code, not charisma

The agent read market data, not slides. No bio, no storytelling.

3. Your process is fragile

If an agent can run a Series B, everything you do before the meeting is exposed.

4. Use the fallback

Simulate your pitch against an agent before talking to a single VC.

5. Test it tonight

Load your deck into a GPT-powered agent and record its questions. Missed one? Pause and revise.
